# langfuse_evaluator (Resource)

Manage an evaluator in a project using project-scoped credentials. An evaluator describes how to score data; evaluation rules decide which data is scored. Changing the definition (prompt, model, variable mapping, output definition, or source code) creates a new evaluator version; changing only the name or description does not. Code evaluators are only accepted by deployments that have code evaluations enabled. Import format: project_public_key:project_secret_key:evaluator_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_evaluator" "example" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "helpfulness"
  description        = "Rates how helpful an answer is."
  type               = "llm_as_judge"

  # Omit both to use the project's default evaluation model.
  model_provider = "openai"
  model          = "gpt-4o"

  prompt = jsonencode([
    { role = "system", content = "You are a strict judge." },
    { role = "user", content = "Rate how helpful {{output}} is as an answer to {{input}}." },
  ])

  variable_mapping = jsonencode([
    { variable = "input", source = "input" },
    { variable = "output", source = "output" },
  ])

  output_definition = jsonencode({
    dataType                   = "NUMERIC"
    minValue                   = 0
    maxValue                   = 1
    scoreReasoningInstructions = "Explain the rating in one sentence."
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the evaluator.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.
- `type` (String) Type of the evaluator: `llm_as_judge` or `code`. Changing it forces a new evaluator.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the evaluator.
- `model` (String) Model used by an `llm_as_judge` evaluator. Requires `model_provider`.
- `model_provider` (String) LLM connection provider used by an `llm_as_judge` evaluator. When omitted, the project's default evaluation model is used.
- `output_definition` (String) Score produced by an `llm_as_judge` evaluator as a JSON object with `dataType` (`NUMERIC`, `BOOLEAN`, or `CATEGORICAL`) and its type-specific fields such as `minValue`, `maxValue`, `categories`, `shouldAllowMultipleMatches`, `scoreReasoningInstructions`, and `scoreValueInstructions`. Required for `llm_as_judge`.
- `prompt` (String) Chat prompt of an `llm_as_judge` evaluator as a JSON array of `{role, content}` messages. Variables use the `{{variable}}` syntax. Required for `llm_as_judge`.
- `source_code` (String) Source code of a `code` evaluator. Required for `code`.
- `source_code_language` (String) Language of a `code` evaluator: `PYTHON` or `TYPESCRIPT`. Required for `code`.
- `variable_mapping` (String) Default mapping of prompt variables as a JSON array of `{variable, source, jsonPath}` objects. `source` is one of `input`, `output`, `metadata`, `tool_calls`, `expected_output`, `experiment_item_metadata`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the evaluator.
- `status` (String) Status of the evaluator: `active` or `paused`. Langfuse pauses an evaluator that has no usable model.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the evaluator definition.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_evaluator.example "${PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY}:${PROJECT_SECRET_KEY}:${EVALUATOR_ID}"
```
